symptom_description: A frozen multiscale Ctrl-World adapter learned useful nonzero corrections, but its point-valued local route alternated between all-abstain collapse and harmful execution when coverage was forced. Mean rollout error improved while terminal interaction error and the long-horizon slope regressed. The next trainable mechanism must represent the distribution and uncertainty of each local arm's future regret, preserve zero correction as a baseline policy, and update the adapter only when a nonzero arm has conservative evidence of improvement.
model_family: Ctrl-World action-conditioned spatiotemporal U-Net latent video diffusion with a frozen official backbone, a trainable multiscale history side adapter, and an interaction-local counterfactual correction policy
